meta.title: Specimen Sorter API
meta.subject: lis-crs-spec-ack-svc - one POST to send out or register a tube by USID
meta.author: Ka

slides.headline: Specimen Sorter API
slides.lede: Sorter middleware calls one POST on lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. It sends out or registers the tube by USID, with the validations and packing Specimen Acknowledgement runs today.
slides.notes: Tony Chong reviewed the design on 10 Sep. Since then: no lab on the map (14 Sep), HA APIM as the consumer (15 Sep), and the map PK / column lengths (21 Sep). The Change Request key still has to be created by hand.

slides.title: What this review covers
slides.notes: Spend the time on the four statuses and the sorter map. Those are the decisions.

slides.notes: Middleware cannot call the staff register endpoint on its own, because the packing is built on the screen first. That is why there is a new API.

slides.title: Middleware calls through HA APIM with a gateway key

findings.title: Hospital sent skips the map
findings.body: Sent: Map workbench and user only. Omitted: loesort_hosp.

findings.title: Returned status, labCode, testCode
findings.body: HTTP 200 is not Registered. Bin from status. labCode and testCode are LIS. 500 means retry.

slides.notes: Same hosts and headers as the GCRS-LIS API specification v1.0, but a new APIM product. Business failure codes sit on data.code, never as an HTTP 4xx from LIS.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Station name decides

slides.notes: The sorter must never use the retrieve GET, because of the hard-coded user. Audit rows carry wkbh_id and wkbh_station_name. Hub already has selectWorkbenchsByStationName.

slides.title: Derive Hospital is missing. Sorter ID is defined in workbench

rows: Fallback hospital when request omits it

takeaways.title: Hospital mapping
takeaways.body:
• Omitted hospital: loesort_sorter_id → loesort_hosp
• Hospital sent: skip the map
• Do not seed the map if every caller sends hospital.

takeaways.title: Workbench then user
takeaways.body:
• sorterId finds wkbh_station_name
• User code is wkbh_id on that row, same as labuser_code

slides.notes: No loesort_usercode or loesort_workbench_id. Location and printer stay on workbench. Server name still comes from HospitalService.

slides.title: Only REGISTERED prints, and only after the response

rows: All worksheets, then PHLC, after return
Send-out, tracking logs, SORT_SO and SEND_OUT

slides.notes: A late worksheet does not change a status already returned. Print failure is an ALS warning, nothing more.

slides.title: One synchronous call per tube

stats.label: Labs on the order
stats.body: APS, BBS and MBS return Failure

slides.notes: Print sits outside the 4 second budget, which is why it runs after the response.

slides.title: Seed workbench, open the gateway path, pilot CPS and HMS

left.title: Promotion
steps: Seed workbench: station name = sorter id, user = wkbh_id.
Map row only if hospital can be omitted.
Publish the APIM product and NetworkPolicy.

right.title: Fallback
steps: Stop the middleware. Staff Spec Ack is unchanged.
Drop the map table if it was created.

slides.notes: Confirm the Audit Trail filter shows SORT_* before the pilot, or staff cannot find the sorter's attempts.

slides.headline: Q&A
slides.notes: Likely questions: why not let middleware call the staff register; why hospital sent skips the map; why mixed tubes fail; why user is wkbh_id.
